A tight January for milk margins
An industry news post from the International Cheese Federation website, published in January 2019, detailing the tight milk margins at the start of the year, exacerbated by federal office closures impacting farm support programs. The page also serves as an archive, featuring various categories like advocacy, certification, education, and events, alongside calls to action for membership.
